avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces hydroxychloroquine plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue St. John's Wort at least 2 weeks before starting hydroxychloroquine or switch to alternative antidepressant

avoid_supplements.name: Kaolin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Kaolin-containing antacids significantly reduce hydroxychloroquine GI absorption by up to 50%
avoid_supplements.action: Separate dosing by at least 4 hours; use alternative antacids (calcium carbonate, magnesium hydroxide)

avoid_supplements.name: Digoxin supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Hydroxychloroquine increases digoxin serum levels, elevating toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Monitor serum digoxin levels closely; adjust digoxin dose if concurrent use necessary

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements (high-dose)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May reduce hydroxychloroquine absorption if taken simultaneously
caution_supplements.action: Space supplementation 4+ hours apart from hydroxychloroquine dose

caution_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
caution_supplements.action: Administer hydroxychloroquine 2-4 hours before or after calcium supplements

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin E (high-dose >400 IU daily)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive antiplatelet effects may increase bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Use standard supplemental doses; monitor for unusual bleeding

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may marginally increase hydroxychloroquine levels; effect variable
caution_foods.action: Limit grapefruit consumption or monitor for increased adverse effects

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly delay hydroxychloroquine absorption timing
caution_foods.action: Take hydroxychloroquine consistently with or without food for optimal absorption

monitoring_notes: Hydroxychloroquine has a narrow therapeutic window; monitor for retinal toxicity, QT prolongation, and drug interactions affecting CYP3A4/2D6 metabolism. Regular ophthalmologic exams and baseline ECG are recommended before initiating therapy.
